description: nf-core/scdownstream samplesheet context, aligned to the schema at pinned dev commit d9264b35ed88b648baf157d76bd9b261344fb585 (no release yet). Single-cell QC, ambient RNA and doublet handling, integration, clustering and cell-type annotation, starting from count matrices.

species.help: Set from the cohort's organism: configure_run fills human or mouse from the samples' detected species and asks when none is detected. It picks the bundled cell-cycle gene lists and the gene-symbol lookups. Another species needs cell_cycle_scoring false (no bundled lists). Upstream's fallback is human.

cell_cycle_scoring.help: Scores S and G2M phase per cell, which integration can use as a covariate when cycling cells would otherwise split clusters. Needs species human or mouse; false for any other species, or when the question rules cell-cycle effects out. Upstream scores them.

ambient_correction.help: Set from the matrices the samples have: soupx (upstream's default) needs each sample's unfiltered (raw) matrix and configure_run refuses it without one; decontx works from the filtered matrix alone; none when the matrices were already corrected (an nf-core/scrnaseq CellBender matrix, *cellbender_filter_matrix.h5ad); cellbender or scar when the researcher asks for that model.

doublet_removal.help: true when the question needs doublets gone before clustering, e.g. rare populations or cell counts per cluster; false keeps every cell and only scores doublets in the object for inspection, upstream's default.

integration_methods.help: Comma list from scvi, scanvi, symphony, bbknn, combat, seurat, scimilarity, pca, expimap, scanorama. Set from the design: scvi (upstream's default) corrects batch effects between samples; scanvi also needs cell labels in each matrix's label_col; pca alone when the samples share one batch. scimilarity downloads its model from Zenodo at run time.

clustering_resolutions.help: Comma list of Leiden resolutions. Higher values give finer clusters: add one when the question is about subtypes, drop to coarse ones for broad lineages. Upstream's three are the fallback.

celltypist_model.help: Comma list of CellTypist models matching the tissue (e.g. Immune_All_Low for immune cells) when the question asks for cell-type labels. Models are downloaded by name at run time, which needs outbound HTTPS from the compute node. Upstream's fallback skips CellTypist.

skip_liana.help: true when cell-cell communication is not part of the question, or for a large dataset, since LIANA can run out of memory. Upstream's fallback runs LIANA.

memory_scale.help: Multiplies every process's memory request: raise it (2, 4) for large cell counts, as upstream advises. Upstream's fallback is 1.

tords.help: true when the researcher works in R (Seurat, Bioconductor): also writes the final object as an RDS SingleCellExperiment. Upstream's fallback writes the H5AD only.

pipeline.name: nf-core/scdownstream
pipeline.core_rule: One row per sample: sample, and filtered and/or unfiltered matrix paths (h5ad, h5, rds or csv). NExtSEEK writes one row per A.SCXP: its cell-filtered matrix in filtered, and its raw matrix, when the record has one, in unfiltered. Further per-sample columns name obs columns inside each matrix (batch_col, label_col, condition_col, donor_col) or override QC thresholds.

validation_rules: Write one row per A.SCXP with sample (its UID). The emitter fills filtered and unfiltered from the record's own files: a name with raw or unfiltered in it is the unfiltered matrix.
sample must be unique; a NExtSEEK UID satisfies the pinned pattern ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$.

batch_col, label_col, condition_col and donor_col name columns inside each matrix's obs table. NExtSEEK does not record a matrix's columns, so set one only when the user names it; never guess. An nf-core/scrnaseq combined matrix holds several samples in one file.
Leave the per-sample QC threshold columns out: the schema's sc-best-practices defaults apply. Set one only when the researcher asks for a specific cutoff.
ambient_correction soupx needs an unfiltered matrix on every row; configure_run refuses it otherwise.
The pipeline has no release: it runs the pinned dev commit with Nextflow 26.04.6 and the strict syntax parser.
notes: Starts from matrices, not reads: no genome or reference is passed. The pinned commit's nextflow.config demands Nextflow >=26.04.6 (NXF_VER=26.04.6 on Luria, whose exact 26.04 patch is not recorded) and its main.nf declares a typed params block, so runs use the v2 parser. CellTypist models, scimilarity's model, Azimuth weights and decoupler's Omnipath resources are downloaded at run time when those steps are chosen.

samplesheet_columns.description: Column-level field dictionary for the nf-core/scdownstream input samplesheet (post-alias names).

sample.description: Unique sample id; added to the output objects as obs['sample'].

filtered.validation_hints: Written by the emitter from the record's files.

unfiltered.description: The raw matrix with empty droplets; SoupX needs it.
unfiltered.validation_hints: Written by the emitter when the record has a raw matrix.

batch_col.description: obs column holding batch; without it the whole matrix is one batch.
batch_col.validation_hints: Only a column the user names.

label_col.description: obs column holding existing cell-type labels (scanvi needs them).
label_col.validation_hints: Only a column the user names.

condition_col.description: obs column holding condition (disease state, treatment) for differential expression.
condition_col.validation_hints: Only a column the user names.

donor_col.description: obs column holding the donor or biological replicate; pseudobulk needs it.
donor_col.validation_hints: Only a column the user names.

report_writer_guidance.purpose: Build an nf-core/scdownstream samplesheet from a resolved NExtSEEK A.SCXP cohort (count matrices, e.g. from an nf-core/scrnaseq run).
report_writer_guidance.workflow_role: Selected when the matrices exist and the question needs QC, integration across samples, clusters or cell-type labels. From FASTQ, scrnaseq comes first.
report_writer_guidance.output_expectation: CSV with header sample,filtered,unfiltered (and any obs-column fields the user named).
population_priority: One row per A.SCXP; sample = its UID.
Set ambient_correction from whether every row has an unfiltered matrix.
Ask the user for obs column names before setting batch_col, label_col, condition_col or donor_col.
final_checks: Every row has a filtered or unfiltered path.
soupx only when every row has unfiltered.

runtime.basis: First guess for one 16-CPU Luria node (Nessie's default submit), CPU only (scVI trains on CPU); not yet measured on Luria. Refine from real runs.
